note: DRAFT content written by the Programming Club. Every medical statement must be checked by the Dentistry team (see reviewNotes). Set reviewStatus to APPROVED per case after sign-off; REJECTED hides a case.

cases.title: Night-time toothache

profile.name: Fahad
profile.personality: Busy office employee, tired after two bad nights, a little impatient, wants the pain gone today.
profile.opener: السلام عليكم دكتور، ضرسي اللي تحت ما خلاني أنام البارحة، الله يعافيك شوفه لي.

facts.chiefComplaint: Severe toothache on the lower right, back teeth.
facts.onset: Strong pain started 3 days ago. For a few weeks before that, short twinges with cold drinks that went away quickly.
facts.duration: Attacks for 3 days now; after a hot or cold drink the pain stays for several minutes.
facts.painCharacter: Throbbing; comes on by itself without any trigger; spreads towards the ear and temple; he cannot point to exactly which tooth.
facts.aggravatingFactors: Hot drinks and cold water; lying down at night.
facts.relievingFactors: Painkillers from the pharmacy help a little for a few hours.
facts.nightPain: Woke him up the last two nights.
facts.biting: Chewing on that side is not really painful; he avoids it anyway.
facts.medicalHistory: Healthy, no chronic diseases, no hospital admissions.
facts.medications: Over-the-counter painkillers for the last 2 days. No regular medicines.
facts.habits: Drinks a lot of sweet tea and soft drinks. Non-smoker. Brushes once a day.
facts.dentalHistory: Big filling in a lower right back tooth about 3 years ago. Last dental visit 2 years ago.
facts.systemicSigns: No fever, no facial swelling, eating normally on the other side, feels generally well apart from the pain and lack of sleep.

keyQuestions.label: Location of the pain (which tooth/area)
keyQuestions.answer: تحت يمين، الضروس اللي ورا، بس ما أقدر أحدد أي واحد بالضبط لأن الوجع ينتشر.

keyQuestions.label: Onset and duration
keyQuestions.answer: من ثلاث أيام بدأ الوجع القوي، وقبلها كم أسبوع كانت تجيني نغزات خفيفة مع البارد.

keyQuestions.label: Spontaneous pain (comes on by itself) or only when provoked
keyQuestions.answer: يجيني لحاله بدون أي سبب، حتى وأنا قاعد ما سويت شي.

keyQuestions.label: Response to hot and cold (and whether the pain lingers)
keyQuestions.answer: إيه، الحار والبارد يهيجونه، والوجع يقعد دقايق بعد ما أخلص الشرب.

keyQuestions.label: Pain at night / wakes from sleep
keyQuestions.answer: إيه، صحّاني من النوم آخر ليلتين، وأحس يزيد إذا انسدحت.

keyQuestions.label: Severity and character of the pain
keyQuestions.answer: قوي مرة، ثمانية من عشرة، نبض نبض ويطلع لين أذني.

keyQuestions.label: Swelling or fever (systemic involvement)
keyQuestions.answer: لا ما فيه انتفاخ ولا حرارة، بس الوجع.

keyQuestions.label: Medical history, medications and allergies
keyQuestions.answer: ما عندي أمراض ولا عندي حساسية من شي، بس آخذ مسكنات من الصيدلية من يومين.

diagnosis.label: Symptomatic irreversible pulpitis
accept: التهاب لب السن غير القابل للانعكاس

treatmentOptions.label: Pulp therapy: start root canal treatment (pulpectomy), then a final restoration; pain relief; no antibiotics
treatmentOptions.outcome: الحمد لله يا دكتور، من يوم شلت العصب الوجع راح ونمت زين. باقي أكمل علاج العصب والتلبيسة مثل ما قلت لي.
treatmentOptions.why: Removing the inflamed pulp removes the source of pain; antibiotics do not treat pulpitis.

treatmentOptions.label: Extraction of the tooth (although it is restorable)
treatmentOptions.outcome: الوجع راح بعد الخلع والحمد لله، بس صار عندي فراغ ورا والأكل صاير يعلق. قالوا لي أفكر بزراعة أو جسر.
treatmentOptions.why: Extraction stops the pain, but this tooth was restorable; root canal treatment would have kept it.

treatmentOptions.label: Simple filling over the deep cavity without treating the pulp
treatmentOptions.outcome: حشيته بس الوجع رجع أقوى من أول. صرت أصحى بالليل والمسكن ما يفيد، ورجعت للطوارئ.
treatmentOptions.why: A filling cannot reverse an irreversibly inflamed pulp; the pain continues or gets worse.

treatmentOptions.label: Painkillers and/or antibiotics only
treatmentOptions.outcome: أخذت الحبوب كلها وخف الوجع يومين. بس رجع بالليل نفس ما كان، والحين أحس الضرس يوجعني إذا عضيت.
treatmentOptions.why: Antibiotics do not treat pulpitis without systemic involvement, and painkillers only mask it while the pulp keeps degenerating.

unmatchedOutcome.outcome: الصراحة يا دكتور ما فهمت الخطة زين، سويت اللي فهمته والوجع للحين يجي ويروح. أبي أرجع أتأكد منك.
unmatchedOutcome.why: The treatment plan could not be matched to a known option; a supervisor should review it.

fallbackLines: ما فهمت عليك يا دكتور، ممكن تعيد السؤال؟
والله ما أدري، أهم شي هالوجع اللي عندي.
reviewNotes: Lingering pain to hot/cold, spontaneous pain and night pain are presented as the key features of symptomatic irreversible pulpitis; pain that is hard to localise is included. Please confirm.
Accepted diagnosis synonyms include 'acute pulpitis' (older term). Confirm whether it should earn full credit.
Tooth is described as restorable, so extraction is graded 'partial' and root canal treatment (pulpectomy) 'correct'. Confirm tiers; confirm whether pulpotomy should also count as correct.
States that antibiotics are not indicated without systemic involvement (no fever, no swelling). Please confirm wording.
'Simple filling without pulp treatment' outcome = pain returns and worsens. Confirm realism.
Biting is described as not really painful (no apical periodontitis yet). Confirm this is consistent with the diagnosis.
Outcome texts after 7 days are patient-side narratives; please check they are realistic and non-alarming.

cases.title: Swollen gum behind the last tooth

profile.name: Reem
profile.personality: University student in exam week, anxious and worried it is something serious, speaks politely.
profile.opener: السلام عليكم دكتور، فكي اللي تحت من ورا منتفخ ويوجعني، وما أقدر أفتح فمي زين.

facts.chiefComplaint: Pain and swelling of the gum behind the last lower left tooth.
facts.onset: Started 2 days ago and is a bit worse each day.
facts.painCharacter: Aching, throbbing pain at the back of the lower left jaw, spreading towards the ear. The upper tooth bites on the swollen gum.
facts.relievingFactors: Warm salt-water rinse helped a little.
facts.swelling: The gum over the partly erupted back tooth is swollen; the cheek outside looks slightly puffy.
facts.mouthOpening: Limited; she can only fit about two fingers.
facts.tasteSmell: Bad taste and bad breath, especially in the morning.
facts.swallowing: Mild pain on swallowing; eating on that side is difficult.
facts.previousEpisodes: A milder similar episode about 6 months ago that settled by itself in a few days.
facts.medications: One pharmacy painkiller last night. No regular medicines.
facts.allergies: Allergic to penicillin (skin rash as a child).
facts.habits: Non-smoker. Brushes twice a day but avoids the back because it hurts. Exam stress, little sleep.
facts.dentalHistory: Wisdom teeth never treated; dental check-ups are rare.
facts.systemicSigns: No fever (measured at home, normal). No difficulty breathing. Swelling not spreading to the neck. Feels tired but otherwise well.

keyQuestions.label: Location of the pain/swelling
keyQuestions.answer: تحت يسار، ورا آخر ضرس، اللثة هناك منتفخة.

keyQuestions.label: Onset and duration
keyQuestions.answer: بدأ من يومين، وكل يوم يزيد شوي.

keyQuestions.label: Swelling (gum and face)
keyQuestions.answer: إيه، اللثة ورا الضرس منتفخة، وخدي من برا كأنه منتفخ شوي.

keyQuestions.label: Mouth opening (trismus)
keyQuestions.answer: ما أقدر أفتح فمي كامل، يا دوب يدخل إصبعين.

keyQuestions.label: Bad taste or bad smell
keyQuestions.answer: إيه، فيه طعم مو حلو بفمي وريحة، خصوصاً الصبح.

keyQuestions.label: Pain on swallowing / eating
keyQuestions.answer: البلع يوجعني شوي، والأكل صاير صعب على هالجهة.

keyQuestions.label: Fever / general health / breathing (systemic signs)
keyQuestions.answer: لا ما فيه حرارة، قستها البارحة وكانت طبيعية، وما عندي صعوبة بالتنفس.

keyQuestions.label: Medical history, medications and allergies
keyQuestions.answer: ما عندي أمراض، بس عندي حساسية من البنسلين، طلع لي طفح وأنا صغيرة.

diagnosis.label: Acute pericoronitis of the lower left third molar

treatmentOptions.label: Local care: irrigate and clean under the gum flap (debridement), oral hygiene and warm salt-water rinses, pain relief; antibiotics only if fever or spreading infection; review and plan wisdom-tooth extraction after the acute phase
treatmentOptions.outcome: يا دكتور الحمد لله، بعد التنظيف والمضمضة بالموية والملح الورم خف من ثاني يوم، والحين أفتح فمي عادي وآكل زين. باقي موعد نقرر فيه خلع ضرس العقل.
treatmentOptions.why: Cleaning and irrigating under the flap removes the trapped debris; antibiotics are not needed without fever or spreading swelling.

treatmentOptions.label: Immediate extraction of the lower wisdom tooth during the acute phase
treatmentOptions.outcome: الضرس انشال، بس الأسبوع الأول كان صعب، فكي ورم أكثر وما قدرت أفتح فمي أيام. الحين أحسن بس لسا فيه شد خفيف.
treatmentOptions.why: Extracting during the acute phase with limited mouth opening is harder and more painful; it is usually planned after the infection settles.

treatmentOptions.label: Reassurance only: 'it is just the wisdom tooth coming through, wait'
treatmentOptions.outcome: صبرت مثل ما قلت لي، بس الورم زاد ونزل لرقبتي شوي وصرت ما أقدر أبلع. رحت الطوارئ وحولوني لجراح الفم.
treatmentOptions.why: Without local cleaning the infection can spread to the tissue spaces around the jaw and needs urgent referral.

treatmentOptions.label: Painkillers and/or antibiotics only
treatmentOptions.outcome: أخذت الحبوب وخف الوجع كم يوم. بس أول ما خلصتها رجع الورم والطعم الشين مثل أول.
treatmentOptions.why: Medicines alone leave the debris under the flap, so it recurs; antibiotics are for fever or spreading infection (and she is allergic to penicillin).

unmatchedOutcome.outcome: الصراحة يا دكتور ما فهمت الخطة زين، سويت اللي فهمته والورم للحين يجي ويروح. أبي أرجع أتأكد منك.
unmatchedOutcome.why: The treatment plan could not be matched to a known option; a supervisor should review it.

fallbackLines: عفواً دكتور، ما فهمت السؤال، ممكن تعيده؟
والله ما أدري، اللي يهمني الورم والوجع.
reviewNotes: Presentation: partially erupted lower third molar with gum swelling, limited opening (two fingers), bad taste, pain on swallowing, no fever. Confirm this fits acute pericoronitis without systemic involvement.

Correct plan = local debridement/irrigation under the operculum, oral hygiene, warm salt-water or chlorhexidine rinses, analgesia; antibiotics only with systemic signs or spreading infection; consider extraction after the acute phase. Please confirm.
Immediate extraction in the acute phase is graded 'partial'. Some clinicians extract early; confirm the tier.
Reassurance-only outcome describes spread towards the neck needing referral (non-graphic). Confirm it is realistic and not alarming.
Penicillin allergy is included so that the allergy question matters. Confirm wording.
Accepted diagnosis synonyms include 'operculitis'. Confirm whether it deserves full credit.

cases.title: Gum swelling and a loose tooth

profile.name: Abdullah
profile.personality: Calm shop owner, a heavy smoker, worried he will lose his teeth, answers briefly.
profile.opener: السلام عليكم يا دكتور، طلع لي ورم في اللثة جنب ضرسي، وأحس الضرس صاير يتحرك.

facts.chiefComplaint: Swelling of the gum beside an upper left back tooth; the tooth feels loose.
facts.onset: 4 days ago; the swelling was small and has grown a little.
facts.painCharacter: Dull, throbbing ache; worse when biting on that tooth; the tooth feels slightly 'high'.
facts.aggravatingFactors: Biting and chewing on the tooth; pressing the gum.
facts.relievingFactors: Rinsing with warm water helps a little.
facts.swelling: Localised swelling of the gum on the cheek side of the upper left first molar. No swelling of the face.
facts.pusTaste: When he pressed the gum yesterday a little white, salty, bad-tasting fluid came out.
facts.hotCold: Hot and cold drinks feel normal on that tooth; no lingering pain.
facts.gumHistory: Gums bleed when brushing for years. Last scaling and cleaning more than 5 years ago. Some teeth feel longer than before.
facts.medicalHistory: High blood pressure, controlled with one tablet daily. Blood sugar test last year was normal (no diabetes).
facts.medications: One blood pressure tablet daily. No painkillers yet.
facts.habits: Smokes about one pack a day for 25 years. Brushes once a day, no flossing.
facts.dentalHistory: No big fillings in that tooth, no previous root canal treatment.
facts.systemicSigns: No fever, feels well, no swollen glands, eating normally on the other side.

keyQuestions.label: Location of the swelling/pain
keyQuestions.answer: فوق يسار، اللثة جنب الضرس من جهة الخد منتفخة.

keyQuestions.label: Onset and duration
keyQuestions.answer: من أربع أيام، بدت صغيرة وكبرت شوي.

keyQuestions.label: Pain character and pain on biting
keyQuestions.answer: وجع خفيف ينبض، ويزيد إذا عضيت على الضرس.

keyQuestions.label: Tooth mobility
keyQuestions.answer: إيه، الضرس أحسه يتحرك شوي، وكأنه أطول من اللي جنبه.

keyQuestions.label: Pus discharge or bad taste
keyQuestions.answer: أمس ضغطت عليها وطلع شي أبيض طعمه مالح ومو حلو.

keyQuestions.label: Gum bleeding / gum disease history / last cleaning
keyQuestions.answer: لثتي تنزف إذا فرشت من سنين، وآخر تنظيف جير سويته قبل أكثر من خمس سنين.

keyQuestions.label: Fever / general health (systemic signs)
keyQuestions.answer: لا ما فيه حرارة، وأحس نفسي عادي.

keyQuestions.label: Medical history (e.g. diabetes) and smoking
keyQuestions.answer: عندي ضغط وآخذ حبة كل يوم، والسكر فحصته السنة اللي فاتت وطلع طبيعي، وأدخن من سنين.

treatmentOptions.label: Drainage through the pocket with debridement/irrigation of the pocket (subgingival scaling), pain relief; antibiotics only with systemic signs; then definitive periodontal treatment and smoking-cessation advice
treatmentOptions.outcome: الحمد لله، بعد التنظيف تحت اللثة الورم راح خلال يومين والطعم المالح اختفى. الضرس صار أثبت شوي، وعندي مواعيد تنظيف لباقي اللثة.
treatmentOptions.why: Draining and cleaning the pocket removes the source; antibiotics are not needed without fever, and the gum disease needs ongoing treatment.

treatmentOptions.label: Incision and drainage of the swelling only, without cleaning the pocket or periodontal follow-up
treatmentOptions.outcome: الورم نزل بعد ما فتحته. بس للحين لثتي تنزف والضرس يتحرك شوي، وأحس الورم ممكن يرجع.
treatmentOptions.why: Drainage relieves the acute swelling, but without pocket debridement and periodontal treatment it tends to recur.

treatmentOptions.label: Root canal treatment of the tooth
treatmentOptions.outcome: سويت علاج العصب وتعبت بالمواعيد. بس الورم ما راح والطعم المالح باقي، ورجعت أدور حل.
treatmentOptions.why: The tooth responds normally to hot and cold; the infection comes from the gum pocket, so root canal treatment does not address it.

treatmentOptions.label: Painkillers and/or antibiotics only
treatmentOptions.outcome: أخذت الحبوب وخف الورم. بس بعد ما خلصتها بأسبوع رجع نفس الورم في نفس المكان.
treatmentOptions.why: Medicines alone do not clean the pocket, so the abscess recurs; antibiotics are reserved for systemic involvement.

unmatchedOutcome.outcome: الصراحة يا دكتور ما فهمت الخطة زين، سويت اللي فهمته والورم للحين يجي ويروح. أبي أرجع أتأكد منك.
unmatchedOutcome.why: The treatment plan could not be matched to a known option; a supervisor should review it.

fallbackLines: ما فهمت عليك يا دكتور، ممكن تعيد؟
والله ما أدري، اللي مضايقني الورم هذا.
reviewNotes: Presentation: localised lateral gum swelling, tooth mobility, pus with salty taste, long-standing bleeding gums, heavy smoker, vital tooth (normal hot/cold response), no fever. Confirm this fits a periodontal abscess.

Correct plan = drainage through the pocket plus debridement/irrigation, analgesia, antibiotics only with systemic signs, then definitive periodontal therapy and smoking-cessation advice. Please confirm.
Incision and drainage without pocket debridement is graded 'partial'. Confirm the tier.
Root canal treatment is graded 'common_wrong' because the tooth is vital. Confirm.
Accepted diagnosis synonyms include 'gum abscess' / 'خراج اللثة' (lay terms). Confirm whether they deserve full credit; 'gingival abscess' is deliberately NOT accepted.
Medical history: controlled hypertension, normal blood sugar last year. Confirm this is appropriate and does not change the antibiotic decision.
